title: PerandamΨ — IllustrisTNG → JWST NIRCam Deep Field Simulation
description: Validated mock cosmological deep field synthesized with SpecSynth & FSPS

discovery_profile.class_title: Candidate "Little Red Dot" (JWST High-z Dusty AGN)
discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Compact blue rest-frame UV continuum with sudden, extreme red slope in F277W - F444W = +1.84.

hypotheses.primary: Accreting intermediate-mass black hole (~10⁷ M☉) shrouded by compact, dense dusty torus gas.
hypotheses.alternative: Hyper-dense stellar core (effective radius < 150 pc) with extreme dust attenuation (Av > 3).

spectral_excess.mechanism: Broad-line Hα + AGN torus hot dust continuum

jwst_followup.science_goal: Search for broad Hα line emission (FWHM > 2000 km/s) to definitively confirm black hole virial mass.

discovery_profile.class_title: Extreme Emission Line Galaxy (EELG / [O III] Starburst)
discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Single-band flux surge in F200W (+320% relative to stellar continuum) caused by extreme rest-frame [O III] λλ4959,5007 and Hβ line emission.

hypotheses.primary: Pristine, low-metallicity (Z < 0.1 Z☉) mini-starburst with high ionization parameter producing extreme equivalent widths (EW₀ > 1200 Å).
hypotheses.alternative: Dense Wolf-Rayet star population producing intense ionizing Lyman continuum radiation.

spectral_excess.mechanism: Rest-frame [O III] λλ4959,5007 + Hβ nebular emission

jwst_followup.science_goal: Resolve [O III] / Hβ flux ratio to accurately measure gas-phase metallicity and ionizing photon escape fraction.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Massive galaxy (8.3×10¹⁰ M☉) already completely quenched (SFR = 0.02 M☉/yr) when the Universe was only 1.5 Gyr old.

hypotheses.primary: Extreme quasar blowout: central black hole accretion triggered a cataclysmic blast wave that emptied the dark matter halo of gas.
hypotheses.alternative: Gravitational compaction followed by rapid gas depletion in a hyper-dense early environment.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Measure age of stellar continuum to constrain how fast a 100-billion star galaxy can form and starve in the early cosmos.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Completely undetectable in optical short bands (F090W > 30 mag), but blazing intensely in long-wavelength NIRCam (F444W = 22.1 mag).

hypotheses.primary: Optically-dark, dust-enshrouded starburst with extreme extinction (Av = 3.6 mag), representing the hidden component of cosmic star formation.
hypotheses.alternative: High-redshift dusty submillimeter galaxy (SMG) transitioning into a massive elliptical.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Probe rest-frame mid-infrared PAH dust features at 7.7 μm and 11.3 μm to measure the hidden star formation rate.

galaxies.qc_failure_title: Tier 1: Negative Flux Density in F090W
galaxies.qc_failure_detail: Evaluated F090W flux = -1.42e-33 erg/s/cm²/Hz. Violates non-negative photon emission invariant. Root cause: Background over-subtraction or unmasked interpolation error.
Measured Dn4000 break = 0.42. Astrophysical lower bound is 0.70 (pure O/B starburst). Indicates corrupted continuum or unphysical stellar population synthesis grid interpolation.

galaxies.qc_failure_title: Tier 2: Stellar Age Exceeds Cosmic Time at z=7.2
galaxies.qc_failure_detail: Derived mean stellar age = 8.4 Gyr. At z = 7.2, the age of the Universe is only 0.74 Gyr. Impossible physical paradox (stars older than the universe).
Evaluated [F150W - F444W] = +4.85 with [F200W - F277W] = -1.92. Lies > 5 standard deviations outside cosmological locus. Flagged for automatic quarantine.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Violent starburst producing 93.1 M☉/yr at z=2.27. Intense rest-frame UV radiation produces extreme blue color [F150W - F444W] = -2.96.

hypotheses.primary: Major gas-rich disk merger triggering catastrophic gravitational gas collapse and star formation at 50x Milky Way rate.
hypotheses.alternative: Massive cold-stream accretion funneling pristine cosmological gas into a nuclear starburst core.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Resolve Hα and [N II] velocity dispersion to map merger kinematics and search for galactic superwind outflows.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Massive galaxy (1.2×10¹¹ M☉) at z=2.22 with near-zero star formation (SFR = 0.012 M☉/yr) and prominent 4000 Å break.

hypotheses.primary: Radio-mode supermassive black hole feedback injected kinetic energy, expelling all cold star-forming gas.
hypotheses.alternative: Shock-heating of the massive dark matter halo preventing gas from cooling to form stars.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Measure post-starburst Balmer absorption lines (Hδ) to constrain the lookback epoch of star formation quenching.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Most massive galaxy in the field (log M* = 11.48, ~300 billion solar masses) assembled when the universe was only 2 Gyr old.

hypotheses.primary: Rapid hierarchical clustering in an extreme cosmological dark matter peak (protocluster core progenitor).
hypotheses.alternative: Hyper-efficient star formation in early dark matter halos driven by a top-heavy initial mass function.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Map spatial distribution of companion satellite galaxies to confirm protocluster environment.
